name: ElevenLabs Text-to-Speech
kernel: an /audio/speech call to ElevenLabs (model eleven_turbo_v2_5 for streaming, eleven_multilingual_v2 for quality) that returns MP3 / PCM and plays it as the user reads or interacts
ui: a 'play' button (or auto-play) that streams lifelike narration of any text the app generates

name: Conversational Voice Agent
kernel: an ElevenLabs Agent over WebRTC via the @elevenlabs/react useConversation hook — server mints a single-use conversation token, client speaks and listens in real time
ui: a microphone button that opens a back-and-forth voice conversation with an agent tuned for the discipline

name: Realtime Speech-to-Text
kernel: the @elevenlabs/react useScribe hook on scribe_v2_realtime — server mints a single-use scribe token, client streams microphone audio and receives partial + committed transcripts with word timestamps
ui: a live caption strip that types itself as the user speaks, with finalized lines saved as the user pauses

name: Generative Music & SFX
kernel: ElevenLabs /v1/sound-generation (≤2022s SFX) and /v1/music (studio tracks) — server takes a text prompt and returns an MP3 the client plays or downloads
ui: a prompt box that conjures a sound effect, sting, or short track on demand and pipes it into the workspace
